Messages.Author: tocoking
Messages.Body: On eBay I found "Ezmerelda", a VTES ccg card with a vampire that has power 11. Who/what is this card?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson (Rulemonger)
Messages.Body:
Ezmerelda
FN:R
Ravnos
Group 2
Capacity 11
Disciplines: dom tha ANI CHI FOR PRE

Independent:
Ezmerelda has 2 votes. If Ezmerelda is ready during your untap phase, you may remove her from the game to gain 11 pool. +1 bleed.

Messages.Author: tocoking
Messages.Body: WHAT! Those are awesome powers. She's from which set?
